postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

proofs.name: Blueprint scenarios run against the real engine
proofs.claim: Every scenario each blueprint declares, executed by the runtime that would run it in production.

proofs.name: Idempotent email under replay
proofs.claim: Section 6.5: a stable action key prevents duplicate emails, documents, webhooks, or charges.
proofs.detail: 1 email(s) after first delivery, 1 after two full replays. The outbox row was delivered 3 times; the action ran 3 time(s) and every replay short-circuited on the idempotency key.

proofs.name: Concurrent workers never double-process
proofs.claim: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED gives each outbox row to exactly one worker, with no lock waits between them.
proofs.detail: 8 workers claimed 40 rows across 4 distinct worker ids; 40 emails for 40 instances (1 each), 0 duplicated effects.

proofs.name: A dead worker loses nothing and duplicates nothing
proofs.claim: A claimed row is invisible for its visibility timeout, then returns to the queue for someone else.
proofs.detail: Another worker saw 0 rows at +5s and 1 at +45s. The record reached "manager_review" with 1 email sent, not 2.

proofs.name: Timers fire once, on time, and are cancelled on exit
proofs.claim: Section 6.5: relative deadlines and reminders, stored canonically in UTC.
proofs.detail: Nothing at +47h, 1 firing at +49h, 0 on a second sweep at the same instant. 1 reminder sent; 1 pending timer(s) cancelled when the record moved on.

proofs.name: A double submission makes one case
proofs.claim: Section 4.2: duplicates are handled without losing the original audit trail.
proofs.detail: 1 instance from 2 concurrent submissions, 1 receipt sent. The second attempt is still on the record as "duplicate_submission_ignored".

proofs.name: A published version cannot be edited, and a live record keeps the version it started under
proofs.claim: Section 9.2: published versions are immutable; every instance records the version that governs it.
proofs.detail: Editing v1 was refused by the database, not by convention. Editing its event history was refused too. v2 is live, and the in-flight record still runs under v1.

proofs.name: Submission and workflow start are far inside the section 10.4 budget
proofs.claim: Beta targets: acknowledgment p95 under 1.5s, workflow start p95 under 30s.
proofs.detail: Over 100 submissions: acknowledgment p95 23.5ms (budget 1500ms), first action p95 55.2ms (budget 30000ms). Database round trips only, local container.
